summary_en: MS-Japan will acquire the remaining 25% stake in FourQuarters Recruitment Pty. Ltd., increasing ownership from 75% to 100%. The acquisition price is confidential but was calculated using the formula stipulated in the shareholders' agreement executed in January 2024. The stock transfer is scheduled for September 30, 2026.
summary_jp: MS-Japanは、オーストラリアの人材紹介業・派遣業を手掛けるFourQuarters Recruitment Pty. Ltd.の残り25%の株式を取得し、現在の75%から100%へ高める。取得価額は株主間契約に基づく既定の算定方式により算出され、株式譲渡実行日は2026年9月30日予定。
